observation_summary: The source map generator incorrectly uses one-based indexing for original source line numbers, while the specification and other fields (like column numbers) require zero-based indexing.
reasoning_summary: The bug report explicitly states that original source line numbers should be zero-based, but are currently one-based. This is a procedural error in how the source map data is calculated and formatted. It is not a missing guard (Checking), a simple wrong constant (Assignment/Initialization), or a design-level capability gap (Function/Class/Object). It is a flaw in the computational logic used to generate the source map output.
evidence_used: bug_report_description: 'Original source line numbers are one-based in source maps... Original source line numbers should be zero based as well.'
SourceMapTestCase.java:242-243: 'assertEquals(mapping.getLineNumber(), inputToken.position.getLine() + 1);' (shows the code currently adds 1 to the line number, confirming the one-based logic)

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix involves changing a value, the root cause is the logic of the mapping calculation (the +1 offset) rather than a simple incorrect initialization of a variable.
